sources.snippet: The script needs campplus.onnx (CV2/CV3 speaker encoder) and speech_tokenizer_v3.onnx (CV3 token extractor); both auto-download from HF on first run. --i-have-rights is required: baking turns a real speaker's recording into a reusable voice clone, and by passing it you attest that you have that speaker's consent or that the voice is your own.
